usage: Ginger (薑) is often used to add aroma and flavor in cooking.
Fresh ginger has a strong, spicy smell and firm texture.
In Cantonese, 薑 is commonly used in soups and stir-fried dishes.
Ginger can help improve digestion and reduce cold symptoms.
You often buy ginger in markets either fresh or sliced.
